description: Stable, provider-neutral identity of a material artifact: tenant-scoped namespace (or the reserved 'public' namespace), name, and a semver-compatible version (major.minor.patch with optional prerelease; build metadata is rejected). Identities are immutable: identity + version + content digest are frozen together on the MaterialArtifact (architecture-lock rules 5, 18).
title: Arena ArtifactIdentity v1
